name: @curio/copy
description: Curio shared copy & terminology — status labels, route labels, action verbs, honesty caveats, error/empty copy, and one canonical en-GB currency/date formatting spec. Generated TS module + Swift enum, one source JSON. Consumed by pokemon-tool (web) and curio-capture-ios.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsx scripts/gen-swift.mjs && tsx scripts/gen-kotlin.mjs
